assumptions.assumption: q = exp(2 pi i tau) with tau in the upper half-plane, so 0 < |q| < 1.
The coefficients are reproduced from the published q-expansion of the j-invariant; transcription is a source check, not a proof.
The normalized expression records the first four terms of the expansion; the remaining terms are indicated in the original expression and are not asserted individually here.

candidate-invariants.invariant: The normalized J function J = j - 744 has constant coefficient 0; the 744 recorded in this claim is the constant coefficient of j itself, and 196884 and 21493760 are the coefficients of q and q^2 in both j and J.

evidence.details: Coefficients compared against the q-expansion as published in the source recorded as s1. No formal proof artifact is claimed for this claim.

assumptions.assumption: 196883 and 196884 are read as integers. The arithmetic identity alone does not assert the representation-theoretic reading recorded in the candidate invariant.

candidate-invariants.invariant: 196884 is the dimension of the Griess algebra and 196883 is the dimension of the smallest non-trivial irreducible representation of the Monster group; McKay's observation that the q coefficient 196884 of claim c2 equals 196883 + 1 motivated monstrous moonshine. Recorded as a published observation, not as a proof of moonshine.

evidence.details: Observation as published in the source recorded as s2. No formal proof artifact is claimed; the moonshine correspondence is not established by this arithmetic identity.

verification-report.details: The integer identity is exact (residual 0), and exact arithmetic is not a formal proof of the moonshine correspondence. The representation-theoretic interpretation remains a published observation in this record.
